page.overview:
Who is Kairen Stang?

Kairen Stang was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah., Kairen Stang}}

She was described as being beautiful, with an oval face and icy blue eyes. She is 5'4 tall.

Kairen was of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.

She is the third weakest among the sisters making up the Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn, with only Berenicia Morsad and Valinde Nathenos being weaker and Demira Eriff being her equal. She is, however, only slightly weaker than Merana Ambrey and several others.
